TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: a purse of silver
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Three hundred silver, counted, in a heap on the ground. It is the smallest thing the crown finds worth answering.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: a chest of silver
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Fifteen hundred silver. Enough to buy a caravan's worth of anything, and it costs rather more than a caravan's worth of walking.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: gold, by the bar
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Two hundred bars of gold, still warm. Kings have been buried with less, which the crown would know.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: a good supper for everyone
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Twenty fine meals, hot, on the ground where the company can reach them. The cheapest wish there is, and still not free.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: a lavish feast
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Twelve lavish meals: the sort of table a lord sets when he wants something. Nobody has to cook and nobody has to hunt.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: drink for the whole company
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Forty bottles of beer. The crown does not appear to think less of the wearer for asking.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: chocolate
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Thirty bars of it, which is a strange thing to spend part of a life on, and people do.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: a masterwork longsword
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Plasteel, masterwork, balanced for the hand that asked for it. It will outlast the wearer, which after this is not saying much.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: a masterwork mace
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Plasteel, masterwork. For the armoured problems.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: a masterwork greatbow
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: A greatbow of the kind that takes a bowyer a season and a wearer a wish.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: a masterwork suit of plate
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Plasteel plate, fitted while it appears. The crown has strong opinions about how a king should be dressed.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: a legendary lute
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Yew and bone and gut, and something in the grain that was not there in any tree. A bard could spend a life looking for this one. That is roughly the exchange rate.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: a small sculpture in gold
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Excellent work, in gold, of nobody the wearer recognises. It is very beautiful and it is looking slightly away.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: a grand sculpture in gold
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Masterwork, in gold, twice the height of a man. Whatever it depicts, everyone who looks at it agrees it is worth what it cost, and nobody wants to say the number out loud.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: to be happy for a while
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Not a thing that can be put down or handed on. For three days the wearer will be well, and pleased, and will not be able to say why.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: to defeat my enemies
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Every hostile thing standing on this ground stops standing. No blow is struck. Nothing is thrown. The crown is told the result and produces the result, and everyone who watches it happen will remember that it was this easy.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: to be loved
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description: Everyone in sight decides, privately and all at once, that they think the world of the wearer. None of them will be able to say when they started, and none of them will think to ask.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.label: to be healed
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_WishDef.description:
Every wound closed, every scar gone, every missing piece back where it belongs, in the time it takes to draw a breath.
The years it charges for this are not returned with the arm.

li.label: wished for happiness
li.description: Everything is fine. Everything is, in fact, wonderful, and there is no reason for it, and the reason does not seem important.

HediffDef.label: crowned
HediffDef.description: This person is wearing the crown of Aldruin, whole. It answers whatever they ask of it and takes the payment out of their remaining years, on the spot. It cannot be removed while they live.
